paper_title: Stellar limits on scalars from electron-nucleus bremsstrahlung
notes: Headline result: WD luminosity-function bound on the baryophilic scalar coupling g_B (scalar to baryon/nucleon number), the paper's main novelty (previously-overlooked m_e/m_N suppression in g_B). Abstract quotes g_B <= 7e-13; from Eq.(4.11a) alpha_B <= 3.4e-26 with g_B = sqrt(4*pi*alpha_B) = 6.5e-13 (rounded to 7e-13). Flat over the applicable mass range: bounds apply for m_phi <~ 1 keV (=1000 eV) and are the strongest for m_phi >~ eV; for m_phi <~ 0.5 eV fifth-force/long-range measurements dominate, so the flat WD line is drawn 0.5 eV - 1 keV. Nominal 95% C.L. Stellar cooling bound, independent of DM density (dm_density null). Paper also gives leptophilic g_L <= 4e-16 (alpha_e <= 1.2e-32) and Higgs-portal sin theta <= 1.9e-10; g_B chosen as the presented main result. Convention label 'coupling (dimensionless)' covers ScalarNucleon/ScalarBaryon plane.
